about: Revision r1 annotations, one per observation row of ../observations.json (kept unchanged). Written after the r0 comparison was known; it re-reads what each row's text and recorded direction mean. It changes no direction, no class of r0 and no model input. `wording` is a short phrase from the span read. `stated` is what the wording states: increase, decrease, no_change_observed (a change was looked for and none seen), no_increase (only an increase is ruled out; a decrease is not addressed), or none. `series` groups rows that the text attributes to the same experiment series, by the figure panel the text itself names (no figure was read). `limit_cause` is set for the rows r0 classed 비교 불가: out_of_model_scope (the model has no node for it), no_scenario_or_mapping (no scenario, or the intervention or condition has no mapping), not_secured_in_spans_read (the spans read do not give it; this does not mean the paper has no data).
